subject.title: feat(plugins): add session followup turn API and gateway-restart extension

question: Should OpenClaw expose an owner-trusted plugin followup API that can wake arbitrary sessions, and should gateway restart recovery be plugin-owned or remain on the existing host-owned restart sentinel path?
rationale: This crosses a public plugin API boundary, session/auth policy boundary, and whole-gateway restart boundary; automation cannot choose the permanent trust model or compatibility contract.

options.title: Redesign as host-owned continuation
options.body: Keep the work open but require a narrower runtime API that uses trusted session context, preserves full run policy, and delegates restart through the canonical gateway sentinel path.

options.title: Approve public plugin API direction
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly sponsor the cross-session followup API, but the PR still needs security fixes, docs/contract tests, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Move restart plugin out of core
options.body: If the core API is not ready, close or pause the bundled plugin and revisit it as an external ClawHub plugin after the required SDK seam exists.

recommendation.title: Redesign as host-owned continuation
recommendation.body: Keep the work open but require a narrower runtime API that uses trusted session context, preserves full run policy, and delegates restart through the canonical gateway sentinel path.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to Peter Steinberger for restart/followup ownership and adjacent policy decisions.
